prompt.text:
Use case: identity-preserve. Repose the existing Ghost Script Calligrapher Boy into ONE independently drawn animation frame. Square single full-body PNG, genuine transparent RGBA, highest polished drawing fidelity. No sheet or labels.
INPUT1 = same-direction combat keyframe EDIT TARGET, authoritative identity, camera, head/body scale, foot baseline and costume. Redraw its body articulation into the exact requested DIFFERENT pose, never merely translate, copy, mirror, warp or interpolate.
INPUT2 = same-direction idle reference, anatomical handedness and relaxed pose reference for recovery; do not change camera to face front.
INPUT3 = full identity portrait, costume/brush/blank scroll details only, ignore its frontal pose.
INPUT4 = PRIMARY APPROVED STYLE reference: bright clean, rounded Daoist chibi hand painting with fine warm-gold, jade and ivory materials; no UI or added characters.
LOCKS: face and nose stay in the specified SIDE PROFILE. Brown tousled short hair/high tied tuft, yin-yang jade/gold hairpiece, teal ribbon ending in PLAIN cloth without added beads/tassel, forehead jade diamond. Charcoal short gold-cloud robe and ivory sleeves, jade belt yin-yang buckle, black/gold shoes. Anatomical RIGHT hand has ONE large black brush, jade/gold fittings, white bristles/dark tip; its ONE teal tassel is attached at the HANDLE BUTT, never the brush-head ferrule, never floating loose. Anatomical LEFT hand has ONE hanging blank ivory scroll with cloud border, black/gold rods and yin-yang tassel. Exactly TWO pale cyan ink spirits hover near that scroll throughout. No extra arm/hand/leg/brush/scroll/spirits, no written characters.
MATCH INPUT1 canvas scale and planted root; feet articulate in place without screen translation or camera zoom. Keep every limb/prop/ribbon/tail inside the canvas and give tips clear transparent margin. Do not fill the canvas by enlarging the head. Preserve costume motifs between frames. No large magic/impact effects, particles, ground, shadow plate, background, opaque/checkered backdrop, blur or speedlines.
FRAME POSE (implement actual new joint positions; retain all above invariants): attack/E/10. RIGHT side profile, finish the major recovery. Torso becomes upright with a soft knee bend. Anatomical right elbow lowers from the ribs and the brush rotates toward a relaxed forward diagonal, still a little higher than resting; anatomical left hand allows the blank scroll to hang vertically beside the hip. Exactly two spirits settle into a separated high-low arrangement beside it; ribbon and tassel make a small opposite settling curl. Feet remain at the reference contacts.

CONTINUITY NOTE: Draw this ONE requested independent frame, native square at least 1024 px; match input1 native 1254-square composition with virtual planted floor y≈1155. Keep head diameter constant across the sequence. Fix all edge tangencies: each brush tip, scroll, ribbon and spirit must have at least 5% transparent margin, without shrinking the whole character. Spirits must be anatomically simple separate clear silhouettes and stay close to scroll. No colored fringe or noisy ghost pixels. Target visual quality GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst / max; product route is host-managed.
